title: Settle before terminal closeout
when: Before closing an item or release while an execution, verdict or review may remain unsettled.
need: Run a correction with its selected plan and exact replacements: only its correction rows run, shared target identity remains, and frozen replacement scopes prevent private duplicates. In-flight host abort records cancellation, stops between steps, and retains custody until restore proof is recorded. If required restoration fails, stop the old runner; the lease holder or a covering steering seat resets every retained host to the interrupted baseline, then retries abort. Recovery proof must match the host and lease and postdate cancellation; reset alone retains custody. On done or cancelled items, a covering steering seat can record the first supersession link with --reconcile --source operator after the corrected requirement has qualified passing evidence.
surface: QA settlement gate documentation; existing finalization/recovery
gap: Review question: should completion output distinguish passed, waived/discharged, no-obligation and still-unanswered checks instead of a single done claim?
review: Focused regression coverage verifies selected correction routing and host cancellation; deployed proof remains required.
